name: retail-media-demo
description: Retail Media / AdTech demo: catalog-backed campaign builder and live ad delivery.

scripts.setup:storefront: npm run build:shared && node scripts/with-keychain.mjs campaign-api -- npm run setup:storefront -w services/campaign-api
scripts.import:products: npm run build:shared && node scripts/with-keychain.mjs campaign-api -- npm run import:products -w services/campaign-api --
scripts.dev:campaign-api: node scripts/with-keychain.mjs campaign-api -- npm run dev -w services/campaign-api
scripts.dev:ad-delivery-api: node scripts/with-keychain.mjs ad-delivery-api -- npm run dev -w services/ad-delivery-api
scripts.dev:worker: node scripts/with-keychain.mjs worker -- npm run dev -w services/worker
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/with-keychain.mjs web -- npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w services/campaign-api && npm run test -w services/ad-delivery-api
scripts.build:web: node scripts/with-keychain.mjs web -- npm run build -w apps/web
